{{Quote|Nothing disturbs me greater than to see one of the Alliance's best go against his own comrades. Lt. Ma'w'shiye's betrayal at Sanjin cost us more lives and equipment than any other operation its size, and his attempts on his former partners are disgusting.|[[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="AJ4" />}}
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sent [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sanjin/Legends|Sanjin]].

==The mission==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sent a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces]] on a covert operation at [[Sanjin/Legends|Sanjin]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ma'w'shiye]], a decorated veteran of countless Rebel missions, was part of the operation.<ref name="AJ4" />

For unknown reasons, Ma'w'shiye betrayed his squadron and stole the team's escape [[Starship/Legends|craft]]. His heartless desertion resulted in the immediate execution by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] of eleven Rebel [[Agent/Legends|agents]] integral to Alliance activities near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Ma'w'shiye's betrayal was expensive to the Alliance, as it costed more lives and equipment than any other operation its size.<ref name="AJ4" />

==Aftermath==
From that point on, Ma'w'shiye turned against his previous partners and allies. He unsuccessfully tried to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] his former comrades of [[Eclipse Team]], who had become [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He managed to kill other New Republic agents including [[Candra]], [[Klepish]] and [[Saloor]], as well as at least seventy-two non-affiliated civilians. New Republic analysts were surprised at this low figure, as Ma'w'shiye was such a skilled [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]] that he could have killed many more if he wished.<ref name="AJ4" />

[[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] confirmed that Ma'w'shiye had not joined the Galactic Empire. Nonetheless, the New Republic branded him as a threat to its members, offering a 70,000-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|reward]] for his capture. A [[New Republic Special Forces/Legends|New Republic SpecForces]] team was formed to track and capture Ma'w'shiye, and the survivors of his assassination attempts were assigned to lead it.<ref name="AJ4" />
